instruction: A candid action photograph shows a sparring match inside a karate dojo with yellow walls, weapon racks, and red-and-blue floor mats. In the right foreground, the older man in a black karate uniform with white stripes (R1) is positioned with his back partially to the camera, facing left with his hands raised in a guard. On the left, the woman in a black karate uniform with a red belt (R2) stands facing him, also with her hands up in a defensive guard. The bright overhead lighting creates a clear, well-lit view of their sparring stance.
elements: R1 is the sparring participant with his back partially to the camera and his hands raised in guard
R2 is the sparring participant facing R1 with her hands up in a defensive guard
R1 and R2 are squared off against each other in karate sparring stances
Both R1 and R2 keep their hands raised defensively during the sparring match
The sparring takes place on red-and-blue floor mats
The setting is a karate dojo with yellow walls and weapon racks

questions.q: Is R1 the sparring participant with his back partially to the camera and his hands raised in guard, rather than R2 being the one with his back partially to the camera?
questions.element: R1 is the partially back-turned guarded sparring participant

questions.q: Is R2 the sparring participant facing R1 with her hands up in a defensive guard, while R1 is the one turned partly away from the camera, rather than the reverse?
questions.element: R2 faces R1 defensively while R1 is partially back-turned

questions.q: Does R1 keep his hands raised in a guard toward R2 while R2 also keeps her hands up defensively toward R1?
questions.element: R1 and R2 both maintain defensive hand guards toward each other
